description: Source code for GuzzleHttp's Client class, implementing an HTTP client with methods for sending requests asynchronously and synchronously, handling request options, and managing configuration.

classes.name: Client
classes.description: HTTP client class for sending HTTP requests asynchronously and synchronously, with configurable options and support for PSR-7 messages.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Client with configuration options, setting default handler and base URI.

methods.name: __call
methods.description: Handles dynamic method calls for HTTP methods, supporting async variants.

methods.name: sendAsync
methods.description: Sends an asynchronous HTTP request with given request and options.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a synchronous HTTP request by waiting for the async request to complete.

methods.name: sendRequest
methods.description: Sends a request following PSR-18, with default options for redirects and errors.

methods.name: requestAsync
methods.description: Creates and sends an asynchronous HTTP request with specified method, URI, and options.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Creates and sends a synchronous HTTP request.

methods.name: buildUri
methods.description: Builds a complete URI by resolving base URI and handling IDN conversion.

methods.name: configureDefaults
methods.description: Sets default request options and headers based on configuration.

methods.name: prepareDefaults
methods.description: Merges default options into request options, handling headers and null values.

methods.name: transfer
methods.description: Transfers the request through the handler stack, returning a promise.

methods.name: applyOptions
methods.description: Applies request options to a PSR-7 request, modifying headers, body, and other parameters.

methods.name: invalidBody
methods.description: Returns an exception for invalid body parameter usage.
